intelligence.human_view: Think of it like a book that fits in your hand. A smart note is the short version — the whole book in a minute, in plain words, from three points of view, ending with what's in it for you. Flip it over and the Naya Note is the full deal — everything behind it, the depth, the math, the root — just for you, private, in your own vault. A post is different: that one is yours to write, straight up, and the big ADD button at the bottom is how you add it. Every one of them wears the same beautiful frame, like a picture in a gallery, and a picture inside it gets its own frame on top, whole, never cut. And someone keeps a list of every part — the frame, the bar, the buttons — and checks the list every time, so nothing quietly goes missing the way the Hub frame did. When his eye says a version is not right, we go back to the one his eye liked. One base, one link.
intelligence.simple_view: A smart note is a tiny block that teaches you a whole book in one minute! It tells you what it is, why it matters, and what is in it for you! A Naya note is the full deal on the back, just for you, and it stays private! A post is yours to write, and the big ADD button is how you add it! Every block wears a pretty frame, and the picture sits on top in its own frame! We keep a list of every part, so nothing goes missing!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — a smart note is the whole book in a minute, dear, in plain words a child can follow, ending with what's in it for you! Flip it over, love, and the Naya Note is the full deal behind it — all the depth, just for you, private, in your own vault, never shown to the world! A post is yours to write yourself, dear, straight up, and the big ADD button at the bottom is how you add it! Every block wears the same beautiful frame, love, and a picture gets its own frame on top, whole and never cut! And someone keeps a list of every part, dear — the frame, the bar, the buttons — and checks it every time, so nothing quietly goes missing the way the Hub frame did!
intelligence.naya_view: Build every block to this anatomy, in his order: Human · In a Nutshell · Child + Grandma · Ultimately What It Means · Why It Matters · How It Connects · How to Apply/Use · What's In It For You; Naya Note + Machine Note on the back, each board three to four lines, tap to see more. Give each perspective its own job — child is the simple picture, grandma is what lasts, human is what you do — so they cannot repeat each other. The Naya Note is the full scope in the same beautiful block formatting; it speaks three languages (search engines, Naya, all AIs); it is private by default, personal feed only, in the Smart Vault; a smart note carries NO name, a Naya note MAY carry the name; on the feed it renders like a smart note MINUS the social part — no rate, no comment, no like, no share. Build the flip: one button, front (smart note, distilled) to back (Naya Note, full scope), same board format, each block opening on its own to its full depth; the Machine Note stays machine-only, never shown. The flip was wrongly removed as invented and he confirmed it again — it goes back in. The smart post is ONE block, not auto-formatted, verbatim, public or private, share, images — the ADD button on the bottom bar IS the smart post. Settings carries two toggles, "unformat Naya notes" and "unformat posts" — unformatted is one elevated block, verbatim as inputted, no auto-organization; a smart note can NEVER be unformatted, the public standard holds. The taxonomy: smart note auto-formatted / public / social / no name / cannot unformat; Naya note auto-formatted / private / no social / may carry name / can unformat in Settings; post not auto-formatted by default / straight up / social share part; images on all of them. Wrap every block in the NayaNET frame; restore the Hub's lost frame verbatim from the last version that had it, bottom part exactly as is; image on top, full width, own frame like a stage, whole and uncropped, headline below, text under, frame growing to hold it, no scrolling inside, movable below the text. Keep the inventory of every page's parts; every round, every walk, every check runs against it — a missing part is a fail before it reaches his eye. Re-base on fix-1e and stay there: one base, one link; the opened note wears the same framed block as the feed card and carries the universal bottom bar, render-verified on the opened note itself — bytes are not proof, the render is. Deliver the AI Activation as ONE document, "Smart Notes / Naya Notes Activation" — the customer uploads the PDF into their AI or copy-pastes it, and their AI knows how to put smart notes and Naya notes into NayaNET in the beautiful formatting; a downloadable copy goes to Shawn too. Do NOT lock in what he left open: whether Apply is its own board or the same board as Connects; the Apply/Use board colour; the see-more shape; the Naya post's privacy and social status; the "posting options" fragment.
